a.description: array_like An array of integers or booleans whose elements should be packed to bits.

axis.description: int, optional The dimension over which bit-packing is done. ``None`` implies packing the flattened array.

bitorder.description: {'big', 'little'}, optional The order of the input bits. 'big' will mimic bin(val), ``[0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1] => 3 = 0b00000011``, 'little' will reverse the order so ``[1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] => 3``. Defaults to 'big'.

output.description: ------- ndarray Array of type uint8 whose elements represent bits corresponding to the logical (0 or nonzero) value of the input elements. The shape of `packed` has the same number of dimensions as the input (unless `axis` is None, in which case the output is 1-D).
